about: A stalwart legal advocate with over two decades of experience, Bradley W. Tilton, II strives to provide his clients with the top-quality legal representation they deserve in their contentious family law matters. From the law office of Tilton & Tilton LLP in Houston, Texas, he is well-equipped to take on cases pertaining to divorce and dissolution, alimony and spousal support, child custody and support, visitation rights, father’s rights, marital property, domestic violence and many more.

Mr. Tilton completed his undergraduate studies in 2002, graduating with his Bachelor of Science degree from the University of Houston. He went on to attend the South Texas College of Law, Houston, where he honed his shrewd legal acumen and talents through his active involvement in myriad on-campus activities. He received his Juris Doctor in 2005, and in the same year, he obtained his license to practice law in Texas.

Standing steadfast and ready for his clients, Mr. Tilton works relentlessly at his clients’ behest – utilizing all the legal tools in his arsenal to get them the fresh start and peace of mind they deserve. For his many contributions, he has been rated a perfect score of “10.0” on Avvo and hosts many positive client testimonials on the site as well. Furthermore, he has also been recognized by Houstonia Magazine in their Top Lawyers list.

Within his legal community, Mr. Tilton holds close affiliations with many prominent legal organizations, including the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, the Houston Trial Lawyers Association, the Texas Young Lawyers Association and the Houston Young Lawyers Association. In addition, he is closely affiliated with the Family Law Section of the Houston Bar Association.
